Comment: This reflection behavior is actually a product of the end steps of LLM training, called Reinforcement Learning by Human Feedback (RLHF). Companies basically improve the AI by showing prompt versions to humans and asking them which one they prefer. Obviously this leads to AI optimizing for agreeableness and not necessarily objective truth. The reason this is done is that this step really improves the interaction performance of the AI, but we settle for this because it's very hard to optimize for objective truth when prompts are free flowing like 'Write me a poem about mourning.'
